Janjati mahilaon ke sath ho rahe atyachar ke virodh men bhajpa anusuchit janjati morcha ne aaj mangalvar ko lokabhvan ke samaksh dharna diya. is dauran bijepi karyakartaon ne nabalig ke sath dushkarm mamle men aarop ke ghere men aae kangres vidhayak bhushan bara ki giraphtari ki mang ki.
